about: EMPTY layers (r177, docs/effect-layers.md phase 0): each page has an EMPTY layer named 'slot' fourth from the back (sizeRatio 0.6, padded, mirror set, which an EMPTY layer ignores), drawn by a hook that stretches the atlas region the scene's 'hooks' names over every tile the reader hands it. e06 adds a PARTICLES layer (r178) naming no effect, which every reader loads and draws nothing for: libGDX logs it, Godot warns once (engines/godot/tests/particles checks its particles, r179), jME never. Read by shots/.../ParallaxShots, engines/godot/tests/shots.gd and engines/jme's JmeParallaxShots.

scenes.name: empty-repeat-X
scenes.about: c01 (Hiver, useOriginalSize, repeat X) with the slot between its fourth and fifth layers

scenes.name: empty-repeat-XY
scenes.about: c02 (repeat X and Y, padded), scrolling up at 30 units/s too: the slot tiles on both axes

scenes.name: empty-repeat-Y
scenes.about: c03 (repeat Y, mirrored layers), scrolling up at 30 units/s too: the slot tiles up, and has no mirrored copy

scenes.name: empty-no-repeat
scenes.about: c05 (no repeat): the slot is drawn once, and scrolls out of the view

scenes.name: empty-cross-fade-tinted
scenes.about: e01 cross-fading into itself (its layers cloned, the slot too) while tinting orange: the hook's tiles fade and tint with their page

scenes.name: particles-skipped
scenes.about: e01 with a PARTICLES layer, anchored to the view, between its two front layers: it loads in all three readers and moves nothing else
